notes.text:
This update for tiff fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-61143: Fixed NULL pointer dereference (bsc#1258798).
- CVE-2025-61144: Fixed stack overflow in readSeparateStripsIntoBuffer() (bsc#1258801).
